messages:
elaine: Quick poll — final pre-cut smoke + go/no-go rehearsal. Need canary owners, ops liaison, and a couple of fallbacks. Proposed slot: Thu 10:30 PT (cut Fri 02:00 PT). Who can be on-call for smoke and triage? cc @ops-bot @deploy-bot

luke: I can own the search canary. 👍 will be available at 10:30.

maria: available. I’ll take validation scripts & test matrix. will post link.

sunil: I can be ops liaison for the window. will surface routing steps to infra.

jordan: I can be fallback for canary owners. heads up — OOO 11:00–12:00 but fine before.

frank: please add rollback checklist to agenda — last time that was fuzzy.

qa_sre: I’ll run the canary smoke tests. need the test matrix & sample data snapshot.

elaine: added rollback checklist to agenda. @maria please drop the test matrix here. also adding a 15m dry-run 10:15 PT.

maria: here: https://internal.redwood/tests/pre-cut-smoke-matrix v2 — quick snippet below:

```
- Pre-cut checklist:
  - Smoke: end-to-end search + auth + api sanity
  - KV cache warmup: 5% traffic replay
  - Canary: deploy to 10% in prod namespace
  - Observe: latency p50/p95, error-rate, traffic drop for 15m
  - Rollback window: 30m from canary start
  - Notifications: #incidents, #eng-oncall, #product-ops
```

deploy-bot: scheduled rehearsal job for Thu 10:30 PT -> job id: deploy-1855554321-rehearsal :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: paging policy attached. primary on-call: sunil. escalation: neha. runbook link -> https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pre-cut-rehearsal

neha: I can take escalation and coordinate with CS if needed.

elaine: who will route canary traffic? need one hands-on infra person during the 15m window.

sunil: I’ll handle routing with infra. will add explicit CLI steps to runbook and a fallback alias.

jordan: can we do a 15m dry-run at 10:15 to confirm entitlements & secrets?

frank: also confirm who notifies customers in the rollback case — sales ops or cs?

elaine: CS owns external comms; @neha will coordinate with cs-ops and sales if needed. added to agenda.

qa_sre: final preflight tickbox: verify dataset snapshot + seed traffic generator. adding to checklist.

maria: pasted small test matrix snippet into the doc and flagged flaky tests.

elaine: final roster for the rehearsal: canary owners: luke (search), jordan (fallback); validation: maria; smoke runner: qa_sre; ops liaison: sunil; escalation & customer coord: neha; rollback owner: frank.

elaine: invite sent + calendar. Please RSVP and add any blockers here by EOD. thanks! :pray:
